trap.label: tend / prone
trap.wrong: Managers are tend to misread tone.
trap.why: O brasileiro cria “estão tendendo a” com be. Em inglês, tend to é verbo comum, sem be.

mcq.q: Aim, Activities, Rationale, Budget are parts of a…

fix.wrong: Managers are tend to misread tone.

rewrite.prompt: Use tend to: “Managers are usually misreading tone.” (misread)
Use be inclined to: “He tends to agree.”
Use prone to: “She often makes errors.” (is prone to errors)
